title: Tomato Transformation Media
author: Alex Rajewski
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x7dfri6

steps.title: Prepare initial media solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve the required components for each medium in approximately 800mL of MilliQ water using a 1L beaker.

steps.title: Adjust volume and pH
steps.instruction: Bring the final volume to 1L and adjust the pH (±0.03) according to the specified table.

steps.title: Add gelling agent
steps.instruction: Divide the volume into two screw-top jars and add the total mass of the gelling agent required for 1L (if applicable).

substeps.instruction: Note: The powder does not need to be dissolved manually as it will dissolve during autoclaving.

steps.title: Sterilize and supplement media
steps.instruction: Autoclave the media and allow it to cool to approximately 50ºC before adding filter-sterile antibiotics and phytohormones according to the table.

steps.title: Dispense media
steps.instruction: In a sterile hood, dispense the media into the appropriate containers.

substeps.instruction: Store liquid media in the screw-top jars.

steps.title: Store solidified plates
steps.instruction: Once the media has solidified, return the plates to their sleeves, label them, and store at 4ºC for up to several months.
